posts.title: Mercer Premier Game Day vs Connecticut Jr. Rangers at Ice Land
posts.summary: Our Mercer Premier team takes on the Connecticut Jr. Rangers today at Ice Land! Puck drop is set for 1:30 PM. Come out to Hamilton and support the Premier squad or follow along live on BlackBear TV.

posts.title: Mercer NCDC Game Day vs P.A.L. Junior Islanders at Ice Land Arena
posts.summary: Friday Game Day! Chiefs NCDC battle the P.A.L. Junior Islanders tonight at Ice Land Arena. Puck drop is scheduled for 5:30 PM EDT in Hamilton, NJ. Come cheer on the Chiefs in person or stream live on BlackBear TV.

posts.title: Youth Highlights: Chiefs 13U Wins 3-2 Thriller Over NYC Hockey Club
posts.summary: Highlights of the week! Chiefs 13U took home an exciting 3-2 victory against the NYC Hockey Club on Sunday. Owen Bertoli netted the clutch opening goal, assisted by Quinn Danjnowicz!

posts.title: Youth Highlights: Chiefs 12U Takes 6-1 Win Over Flyers Elite
posts.summary: Highlights of the week! Chiefs 12U earned a big 6-1 win over Flyers Elite on Sunday behind a game-winning goal from Gregg D'Antonio Jr, assisted by Oliver.

posts.title: Official Team Store: New Champion & Carhartt Mercer Chiefs Gear Now Live
posts.summary: Two brands every hockey family already knows, Carhartt and Champion, are now available in your Mercer Chiefs team store. Hoodies, winter beanies, outerwear, and player gear are now in stock at shopmercerchiefs.breakawaysports.net.

posts.title: Mercer NCDC Wins Opening Game of Hitmen Classic (6-4 over CJR)
posts.summary: Mercer NCDC opened the Hitmen Classic tournament at the Ice Vault with an exciting 6-4 victory over the Connecticut Jr. Rangers behind relentless offensive pressure and clutch goaltending.

posts.title: Mercer Premier Shuts Out New Jersey Renegades 6-0 at Ice Land
posts.summary: Mercer Premier improved their regular season record to 5-2 with an emphatic 6-0 shutout victory against the New Jersey Renegades on home ice at Ice Land Arena. Congratulations boys! Chiefs Hockey - Discipline. Loyalty. Tradition. Excellence.

posts.title: USPHL Premier Squad Goes 3-1 at Hitmen Classic; Coach Firsov Praises Effort
posts.summary: Congratulations to our USPHL Premier team who went 3-1 at the Hitmen Classic tournament with wins of 1-0, 2-0, and 6-1. Coach Sasha Firsov commended the group: 'It was a great weekend for our group, competing hard every shift.'
